newsitem.title: USA: IMO Industries Q4 oper shr loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: IMO Industries Q4 oper shr loss vs profit.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: The company's continuing operations are comprised of power transmission, pumps, instrumentation, Morse Controls and Roltra-Morse. The company sold substantially all of its Electro-Optical Systems business and its turbomachinery business segment in 1995 and they have been treated as discontinued operations.

1996 results include $24.6 million in unusual charges, related to unit restructuring, impairment of long-lived assets, and write-down of some businesses offered for sale. 1996 also include an extraordinary charge of $8.5 million for debt extinguishment costs.
The fourth quarter and full-year ended December 31, 1995 include unusual charges of $10.2 million for unit restructuring and write-downs.
